$description: Cairn color palette: the single source for every app. Each mode defines the same token names. Edit here, then run `npm run build -w @cairn/tokens`.

primary.$description: Primary actions and selected states (Figma: red/primary)

textSecondary.$description: Secondary text and inactive icons (Figma: red/secondary)

success.$description: Success messages and the archive swipe action

info.$description: Informational states: pending saves and the save-to-Reads swipe action

onAccent.$description: Text and icons drawn on success, info or error fills

floating.$description: Translucent fill of floating pills (tab bar, action bar): card at 85%

shadow.$description: Shadow of floating pills and popovers (Figma)

shadowSoft.$description: Large, diffuse shadow of modal cards
